Assistant (0.2s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Ms Lin?

User (1.7s): Yes, this is Grace Lin.

Assistant (2.1s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (4.1s): Why do you need that?

Assistant (5.1s): These questions protect your account, and I can tell you more once your identity is confirmed. Please go ahead.

User (6.3s): Twenty-third of February nineteen eighty-nine.

Assistant (7.8s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (8.4s): Which account is this about? 9904.

Assistant (9.4s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 7740 has a past-due amount of 365.00, which is 8 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (10.8s): I cannot pay today. I can pay the full amount this Friday.

Assistant (12.2s): To confirm: you will pay 365.00 for the credit card ending 7740 on Friday 16 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (13.4s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (14.5s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (17.5s): Thank you. Your promise of 365.00 for the credit card ending 7740 on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
